mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (all else equal) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.5%, the S&P 500 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on 60-day returns is not significant (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion regimes, INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 on 5-day returns is negative or below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE on 20-day returns is not significant (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession housing recovery, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal renewed consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession housing recovery regimes, HOUST growth fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances.
